question: Can a move-only completion objective improve the original ROOK language-policy base without teaching numeric score tokens?
motivation: v1/v2 language-model pilots reduced action agreement. The separate classifier-v3 gain came with illegal raw moves, and its sequential stress panel exposed failures. None establishes commentary or broad chess understanding.
source: Exact retained4MiB Lichess CC0 puzzle prefix fromv1; no fresh-acquisition claim
rights: Lichess declares puzzle database CC0; pinned modelcard declares MIT; private local training, no weight redistribution
exclusions: Every historical seed and v1/v2/classifier-v3 game, plus both source-before and setup-after board keys for every prior puzzle. New unique games/boards across all splits. Existing holdouts are spent and never used for this selection.

teacher.target: actual legal UCI bestmove at completed search only; retained score-event bounds are observation metadata, never inputs or targets

training.precision: float32 parameters; CUDA bfloat16 autocast where available
training.objective: completion-only UCI bestmove string plus EOS; no score, candidate-list or rationale targets

representation.prefix: P: currentFEN padded to90 characters, then literal M:
representation.target: one space, teacher UCI move, EOS
representation.token_boundary: joint tokenization; reject crossing prompt/completion token and require exact inference-prefix token identity
representation.inputs: currentFEN only; no candidate/score/PV/futureboard/theme/annotation/answer labels beyond separately masked completion supervision

generation.action_parser: strip whitespace and optional initial M: marker; take ONLY the first whitespace-delimited token, require full UCI syntax. Never search later text, use B: output or legal-mask. Retain trailing completion text and explicit parse/legality failures.
generation.task_change: This first-M move policy is deliberately different from the full-native B:first policy in v2. Apply exactly this parser/budget to base and trained; do not compare cross-protocol percentages as strength gains.

selection.criterion: highest raw teacher-match count; then raw-legal count; then earliest step including0base
selection.holdout: save selected weight identity and all development results before opening holdout; evaluate only base and selected weights there, never rejected checkpoints

failure_policy: All planned evaluation rows remain in denominators, including encoding/model/parse/illegal failures. On backend call failure, retain the affected batch and mark remaining requests not_run rather than repeatedly calling the failed backend. Training failures preserve completed artifacts and do not imply a finished run.

resource_policy.gpu: RTX5080; serialize against Ollama, inspect free RAM/VRAM before training
resource_policy.purpose: useful throughput without changing power/thermal controls

retention: exact protocol and all executed source snapshots before model calls
complete generated tokens, raw strings, failure records and unchanged historical runs
promotion_policy: An improved selected checkpoint remains an experimental move-only language-policy candidate. No automatic default replacement, broader understanding, Elo, commentary, teaching or sports-transfer claim.
assistance: Codex-assisted research and implementation. A local27b model suggested invalid-UCI and split-leakage checks; suggestions are not authority or results. Independent practical review required before reporting candidate outcomes; formal commentary gate remains unmet.
